84:1: When the sky is split open.
84:2: And listened to its Rabb and it was right.
84:3: And when the earth is stretched out.
84:4: And when it casts out what is inside it and becomes empty.
84:5: And when it listened to its Rabb and was right.
84:6: O human, surely you keep striving toward your Rabb and you meet Him.
84:7: As for the one who has been given his book in his right hand,
84:8: He will be called to account with an easy reckoning.
84:9: And he returns to his family joyfully.
84:10: And but whoever was given his book from behind him,
84:11: Soon he will call for destruction.
84:12: And he enters a blazing fire.
84:13: Surely he was joyful among his family.
84:14: Surely he thinks that he will never return.
84:15: Yes, surely his Rabb was seeing him.
84:16: Then I swear by the twilight of the evening,
84:17: And by the night and what it envelops.
84:18: And by the moon when it is gathered.
84:19: Surely you will ride from stage to stage.
84:20: What is the matter with them that they do not believe?
84:21: When the Quran is recited to them, they do not prostrate.
84:22: On the contrary, those who disbelieve deny.
84:23: And Allah knows best what they amass.
84:24: Give them tidings of a painful punishment.
84:25: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there is an uninterrupted reward.
